feeds.title: VoiceArchive
feeds.description: VoiceArchive is a full-service voice over agency. With 5 offices globally, our team of professionals serve as your one-point of contact to assist and collaborate in all voice over projects. Learn more about what's going on in our world. You'll find our many blogposts here with news, inspiration and knowledge.

feeds.title: The Voice Shop | Voice Acting Tips, Resources, & Info
feeds.description: Our mission at The Voice Shop is to establish and develop the skills necessary for you to succeed as a voice over professional. We offer a wide range of classes and workshops taught by industry veterans. Revisit our blog for helpful information and tips for voice acting, among other great content to help you in your endeavors.

feeds.title: Anne Ganguzza
feeds.description: Covers updates and ideas on voice over industry topics, audio, marketing, vocal wellness and more from host, talent and producer Anne Ganguzza

feeds.title: Voicebooking
feeds.description: Voicebooking.com is the first voice agency that works as a webshop where you can book a voice-over for your recording in just a few easy steps. Read our blog to get interesting tips and tricks, how to make an e-learning course, how to mix and master your audio, and many more!

feeds.title: Actors' Sound Advice
feeds.description: Exceptional Voice Actor Training and Voiceover Demo Production. Everything we do is private & one-on-one. Regardless of your skill level or experience, we prepare you to establish, maintain and expand your small business as a professional voice-over and working actor.

feeds.title: The Voices In My Head Blog
feeds.description: Thank you so much for visiting The Voice Actor Blog, a fantasticly insightful Voiceover edutainment blog. Get the inspiration and updates on voice acting along your voice acting journey!

feeds.title: A VO's Journey Blog | Helping voice over artists become successful
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to chronicling my journey as a voice over artist and adding helpful tips and tricks for other voice over artists along the way.

feeds.title: Get Clever About Vo
feeds.description: Get Clever About is an acting & voice acting industry blog to help actors & voice actors start their careers & grow their business. Get to know everything about voice acting at Get Clever About.

feeds.title: Voice Over Gurus Blog
feeds.description: Lesley Bailey is an award-winning Casting Director, Voiceover Coach, Demo Producer, and Consultant who comes as a highly recommended voiceover coach in the inner circles of the industry. She spent ten years as the Head of Casting at a major production company in NYC as well as ten additional years coaching and producing demos. Stay tuned to get the latest updates on voice over blogs.

feeds.title: Tom Dheere...The H Is Silent, But I'm Not!
feeds.description: Tom Dheere, male voice talent with over 20 years of experience narrating commercials, audiobooks, explainer videos, industrials, and more offers a weekly newsletter on his voiceover blog for voice talents around the globe.
